text_block_list.text:
To help Hishi Miracle truly feel her own 
progress, I decided to have her go for a 
morning run every day during the training 
camp.
(PEEEEEP!)
choice_data_list: Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fuehh~, it's way too earlyyy. It's not 
even 8 o'clock yet~. And today's supposed 
to be our free day too~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to wake up around 11, grab 
whatever leftover onigiri was left from 
breakfast, and then get started, but...
choice_data_list: ...Isn't this too late?

text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle's schedule was way, way more 
sluggish than I had imagined...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haa, that was rough~. My body... might not 
even be warmed up yet~.
(Ring-ring!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wah, Trainer, what's that~?
choice_data_list: It's a bike for roadwork.
It's a bike for roadwork, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so you're going to follow me the 
whole time?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Then I won't even be able to take a sneaky 
break, will I~?
choice_data_list: No, I won't let that happen.
Yeah, I won't let that happen.

text_block_list.text:
Taking a break meant feeling less like she 
was working hard. This, too, was for Hishi 
Miracle's sake.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fuehh~, this is seriously brutal. Where's 
my summer gone~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Going swimming! With my frieeends... 
Taking a nice, leisurely! Strollll...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Going swimming! With my frieeends... 
Taking a nice, leisurely! Strollll...

Throughout the run, Hishi Miracle kept 
humming, turning her deepest desires into 
song.
choice_data_list:
Do you want to go swimming or take a walk 
at the beach?

Do you wanna go swimming or take a stroll 
on the beach?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Of course I want to! *sniffle* *sob*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And after that, it's the summer festival! 
Swimming in the sea, going for a stroll!
choice_data_list: I guess I could let you do that, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Really!?

Hishi Miracle comes to a sudden halt. I 
almost rear-ended her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Are you really going to let me do all 
that? Swimming in the sea, taking walks, 
the summer festival!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's do a different menu tomorrow, 
then.

Yeah, let's do a different menu tomorrow 
then.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow! That's a promise. So, which one 
are you gonna let me do?

If I remember correctly, this year's 
summer festival is at the end of August. 
In that case, let's put that on hold—

A lively day at the beach, or a relaxing 
stroll? Which one should I have them do?
choice_data_list: A Super Leisurely Stroll
Super Lively Beach Trip

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Super slow... It feels a bit different 
from a normal walk, though...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Understood. It's a promise.

—And the next day. Instead of running, I 
decided to take her on a leisurely walk.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Mgyeeh, mgygygygy, mguuh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, going for a walk holding this is 
ridiculous... Just how many kilograms is 
it~?
choice_data_list: ...Quite.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You said 'pretty tough'... This is way 
harder than running!"
choice_data_list: Instead, take your time with it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even if you didn't tell me to, I can only 
walk slowly anyway~. Uuuugh~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... Feels like my arms 
are gonna fall off. When was the last time 
I tried this hard?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This might be the first time since I was 
entrusted with a solo in the folk song 
'Shunsaku-bushi' at my kindergarten 
recital~.
choice_data_list: You did great, huh.
You did great, didn't you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Well, thanks to that, I guess I 
might've gotten stronger, though.

By carrying the ultra-heavy box, Hishi 
Miracle grew tougher, both in mind and 
body.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Super lively... It feels a bit different 
from normal sea bathing, though...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Understood. It's a promise.

—And the next day. Instead of running 
today, we made it a beach day, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-hmmm, heh-heh-heh-heh-hmmm~♪
choice_data_list: You're not gonna swim?
Aren't you going to swim?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, the truth is... I absolutely hate 
swimming. I'm so terrible at it I 
practically drown, so... yeah...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"My absolute favorite part of going to the 
beach is lounging around. A soothing sand 
bath is just the best, isn't it~?"

Looking closely, there was sand on the 
swimsuit. If that's the case...
choice_data_list: Guess I'll just have to swim it off.
Guess I'll just have to swim it off.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer. What is that you're holding 
in your hand?
(Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaaa, a can? What are you going to use 
that for?"
choice_data_list:
Chase Hishi Miracle around and make her 
swim

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, I told you I'm super bad at 
swimming, didn't I~?
(Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaaaaaa!

If she stays on the beach the whole time, 
she'll just get lazy. Hardening my heart, 
I chased Hishi Miracle out into the sea.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... That scared ten years off 
my life... Oh, honestly, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So in the end, you were totally planning 
on making me train all along. How meeean.
choice_data_list: You did great at swimming.
You did great at swimming!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, but if I don't give it my all, 
she's gonna get super mad at meee~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Well, thanks to that, I feel like I've 
developed a bit of a thicker skin, but..."

And so, Hishi Miracle survived swimming 
training... disguised as a casual day at 
the beach.
